story.summary: Shopper manages items in the shopping cart
story.description:
As a shopper I want to manage the items in my cart so that I buy exactly what I need.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Clicking "Add to cart" on an in-stock product adds one unit of it to the cart.
- The quantity of a cart line can be changed to any whole number from 1 to 10.
- Removing a cart line deletes it and updates the cart subtotal immediately.
- The cart subtotal equals the sum of unit price multiplied by quantity for every line.
